title: Millie's Yellow Hat
logline: When a big wind blows away Millie's favourite yellow hat, she chases it, but every time it lands, it becomes someone else's.
theme: Something you hate to lose can fill you up when you choose to give it away.

characters.name: Millie
characters.look: A four-year-old girl with a short black bob and a fringe; a yellow hat with a small white daisy pinned to it; a blue and white striped top and red rain boots.
characters.want: To get her yellow hat back.

characters.name: Beans
characters.look: Millie's little brown dog, one ear white, always at her heels.

characters.name: the mouse
characters.look: A small grey mouse with round ears and a long thin tail.

characters.name: the frog
characters.look: A small green frog with a pale yellow belly and big round shiny eyes.
characters.want: To stay out of the rain.

characters.name: the little blue bird
characters.look: A bird the size of a hand, sky blue on the back, white underneath, a black tip to its tail.

setting: A windy spring afternoon, on the path from Millie's front door to the park, with a puddle, a meadow and a big tree.
refrain: Whoosh! The wind blew, and off went the hat!

beats.what: Millie wears her yellow hat wherever she goes, with Beans at her heels.
A big wind blows the yellow hat away.
The hat lands in a puddle and a mouse sails it as a boat; Millie says it's her hat, and the wind blows it away again.
It starts to rain; the hat lands in the grass and a frog shelters under it; before Millie can take it, the wind blows it away again.
The hat catches on a branch; Millie stands on tiptoe and can't reach, and Beans jumps and can't reach either.
A little blue bird carries twig after twig into the hat, and Millie watches it build a nest.
Millie thinks for a long time and decides, on her own, to let the bird keep the hat.
Winter passes, spring comes, and three baby birds peek out of the yellow hat.

ending: A wordless last page: in the spring tree, three baby birds peek out of the yellow-hat nest, the daisy still on the brim, while Millie and Beans look up from below.
style: Watercolour in soft colours: the yellow hat is the brightest thing on every page; pale spring greens, grey-blue for the rain; plenty of white space and loose lines.
